review_scope: Complete measurement driver plus six current cap/copy paths; supporting permanent suites remain pending.

checks.result: Baseline copy-boundary guard rejects changed check-job-log-tail-slice.ts before either measurement phase; no current pass.

limitations: Sixteen records are manual measurements with no value/cap/parity or heap-threshold assertion.
Returned strings are retained, rather than full queue/owner objects; actual ownership lifetime is separate permanent coverage.
Large independent synthetic inputs and forced GC show possible retained parents, not deployed workload size, RSS, growth rate or incident attribution.
Bundle hashes are provenance; transform guards do not fence a complete historical dependency graph.
